# `tag.get`

Show a tag

The tag target with the peeled commit when the object is annotated.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/tags/{tag}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie tag get`
- MCP: `tag_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `tag` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
